title: Translations and localization

partner_applied.actual_use: Upgraded the partner core envelope |phi_T(t)|<=B|t|^-3/4 to a uniform L3 density bound, then fed it to the new moving-fold receiver theorem to pay arbitrary scalar receiver self-curvature.

required_claude_source.completed_result_used: Theorem B: ||p_Q||inf <=2sqrt(2pi) sum_i |P e_i| under the three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis
required_claude_source.actual_application: For Q_a=U1^2+U2^2+aW^2+2ZW the matrix is invertible in dimension four, so P=I4 and the theorem gives ||p_Qa||inf<=8sqrt(2pi), uniformly in a.

main_inequalities: If ||p_Tz||3<=K and Q=T_Z+aW^2+(2v^TZ+d)W, then ||p_Q||inf<=2^(7/6)K||v||^(-1/3), uniformly in a,d and support geometry.
Exact target family Q_a=U1^2+U2^2+aW^2+2ZW obeys ||p_Qa||inf<=2^(7/6)pi^(2/3)=4.815428181530122... for all a.
Worst conditional fold obstruction: for W uniform [-1/2,1/2], ||p_(aW^2)||_(3/2)=2|a|^(-1/3).
localization_principle: Average the moving quadratic receiver critical point against the whole independent product driver before endpoint norm payment. Arbitrary translations and fragmented/unbounded supports remain admissible; taking a worst conditional fold first loses a spurious |a|^(-1/3).
next_step: In surviving N3/no-pivot states, structurally force either a whole-law D'/D5/ridge/mixed-hub/grouped-bank exit or a disjoint driver plus affine-uniform L3 core and scalar receiver. Otherwise derive an aggregate estimate for receiver-core couplings without normalizing active fragments.
